## Beware- was charged separately for an item I did not order after checkout. Company unwilling to cancel item.

Ordered a sweatshirt, submitted my order, and was offered a pair of sweats. I clicked “no thank you”. Then received my order confirmation with a charge for my sweatshirt and then a separate charge for the sweatpants. I immediately messaged them to let them know the error. They said “due to systematic limitations, we are unable to revise orders once confirmed”. I said I understand that but I didn’t order them. They said I could use the return link when I receive them, (which charges $5.95 to ship back). I asked if they were sending me a prepaid label to return them since this was not my error, to which they replied “We don’t have control over the items added to your cart during checkout.”Super disappointed in their response and lack of customer service, especially for a Christian company. Do not recommend.
